notes.title: Celebrate Halloween with Tadeo and enjoy a terrifying discount!
notes.content:
[h1]Celebrate Halloween with Tadeo and enjoy a terrifying discount![/h1]

[b]Halloween [/b]season is here and we have another great news for Tadeo fans! To celebrate these special dates, Tadeo Jones - The Emerald Tablet is available until [b]November 3rd[/b] with an incredible [b]discount [/b]that you won't want to miss. From today, you can enjoy the adventures of Tadeo at a reduced price, it's the perfect time to join his legendary adventures in Halloween mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471845/60c33a7e782ed4a6e542ea4cfde7e6f2560ce875.png[/img]

[b]Here's a reminder of what's new in the Halloween update:[/b]

    - [b]New and terrifying scenarios![/b] Get ready to explore a Chicago full of surprises, both in 2D and 3D, with guaranteed scares and an atmosphere that will make your hair stand on end.
    - [b]Pure Halloween visuals.[/b] Ghosts, pumpkins and bats invade every corner of the game, adding a sinister and fun touch to your adventures.
    - [b]Terrifying sounds![/b] The new soundtrack will keep you in tension, the Halloween sound effects are perfectly integrated into the scenarios to create an even more immersive experience.
    - [b]Spooky gameplay.[/b] Puzzles and challenges tinged with the spirit of Halloween to add an extra dose of excitement.
    - [b]Dressed for the occasion.[/b] Tadeo, Sara and Victoria have decided to join the party with their best costumes for the Day of the Dead.

Don't rest on your laurels, or on your pumpkins, because this magical discount ends on [b]November 3[/b]. Take the opportunity to enjoy the adventures of Tadeo in the purest Halloween style at a scary price... or a laugh!

notes.title: Christmas is coming to Tad The Lost Explorer: The Emerald Tablet!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471845/8827f85838899e514da21d310fade992150eae53.png[/img]
[h1]  Christmas is coming to Tad The Lost Explorer: The Emerald Tablet![/h1]

The adventures of our intrepid archaeologist and his faithful friend Jeff are dressed up with the [b]new Christmas update[/b]:

[previewyoutube=On7KbgtA5Es;full][/previewyoutube]

Our sets are covered with [b]snow, Christmas trees and many surprises[/b]. 
The Tadeo movies come to life for you to enjoy playing through open 3D scenery and 2D platforming levels. 
Visit Chicago, Veracruz, Egypt or Paris and feel the Christmas spirit envelop you as you lead his adventure to save his friends from the curse. 

Who knows..., you might even see [b]Santa Claus cross the sky[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471845/d65f06693e4517022974cb943ee89a14c49871ea.gif[/img]

[b]Featured Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now available in the [b]new free update on PS4, PS5 and Steam[/b]. 
[*] New [b]fully snowy scenery[/b] and the occasional blizzard!
[*] [b]Christmas visual elements[/b] throughout the game. 
[*] New integrated [b]ambience sounds[/b]
[*] Playable elements bathed in the [b]spirit of Christmas[/b]. 
[*] Lovable characters dressed in their [b]Christmas finery[/b]. 
[/list]

notes.title: Tad The Lost Explorer is coming to Nintendo Switch on July 7th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471845/c45d805fa701d928ced2f9ead3e00cd9645c5f60.png[/img]

[h1]Tad The Lost Explorer comes to Nintendo Switch in his most exciting and crazy adventure![/h1]

Since his debut on the big screen, Tad Stones has won the hearts of millions of viewers with his courageous exploits and irresistible charm. Now, Tadeo fans will be able to immerse themselves in the [b]action and excitement of his world anywhere[/b] thanks to the release of [b]Tad: The Lost Explorer, Craziest and Madness Edition on [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/tad-jones-the-lost-explorer-craziest-and-madness-edition-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url][/b], a project signed by [b]Gammera Nest[/b] and [b]Mediaset Games[/b], with the support of [b]Selecta Play[/b], and which is sure to delight the most diehard fans of the lost explorer. 

Get ready for an exciting and crazy adventure with Tad The Lost Explorer on your Nintendo Switch, [b]available from July 7[/b]!

[previewyoutube=KEXKbOalIDo;full][/previewyoutube]

With a captivating[b] 2.5D[/b] perspective, Tad: The Lost Explorer, Craziest and Madness Edition transports players to the [b]exotic and dangerous settings[/b] that have made the intrepid adventurer famous. From the lost ruins of Veracruz to the interior of Egypt's Great Pyramid, each level is meticulously designed to deliver a visually stunning and challenging [b]experience[/b].

[b]Featured Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]2.5D perspective[/b] of the movie sets.
[*] The game will feature [b]four playable characters[/b], each with unique and exciting abilities:
[*] Narrative in the purest [b]Tad Stones style[/b].
[*] Fun [b]comic-book cinematics[/b] full of references.
[*] Available on Nintendo Switch from July 7th, [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/tad-jones-the-lost-explorer-craziest-and-madness-edition-switch/]add it to your wishlist[/url].  
[/list]

notes.title: New Update for Tad: The Lost Explorer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471845/c45d805fa701d928ced2f9ead3e00cd9645c5f60.png[/img]
[h1] New update for Tad: The Lost Explorer [/h1]

Attention Tad fans! The faithful adventure based on the Tad: The Lost Explorer movie has a [b]new update[/b]:

[h3][b]New comics![/b][/h3]
The new update brings us a very exciting new feature.... [b]NEW COMICS![/b], the [b]comic vignettes[/b] present in the videogame have been updated with a [b]new and amazing style[/b], and that will surely get you to smile with its countless [b] references and hidden details[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471845/44bee7a69e429bd924c49a615b16b684b83cc2eb.gif[/img]

Remember that in Tad: The Lost Explorer you will find a[b] adventure faithful to the movie[/b]. You will have to guide Tad's steps to [b]free his dear friends[/b] from the curse that affects them. The adventure stands out for its variety, the alternation of [b]open 3D scenarios[/b], which can be fully explored (Veracruz, Chicago, Paris, Egypt), and [b]2D platform levels[/b], in which the player's skill will be essential.
 
That is to say: scenarios to fall backwards, hours of excitement, platforms, combat, collecting, puzzles... We must also highlight the graphic section, very close to that of the film both in design and animations. 

[b]Featured content:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Narrative[/b] in the purest Tad Stone style.
[*] [b]Freedom[/b] to explore the [b]3D scenarios[/b], full of objects to collect and adventures.
[*] Action in the [b]2D levels[/b], to show your skill at the controls.
[*] Countless [b]references and surprises[/b].
[*] Funny [b]comic cinematics[/b].
[*] Already [b]available on [url=https://store.playstation.com/es-es/concept/10004674]PS4, PS5[/url] (also in physical format) and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966690/Tadeo_Jones_La_Tabla_Esmeralda/?l=english]Steam[/url][/b].
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966690/Tadeo_Jones_La_Tabla_Esmeralda/?l=english
